extracted.name: Pancakes
extracted.description: These pancakes are perfect for evening snacks and even for breakfast. These pancakes go best with butter. Do try this quick, easy and delicious recipe of Pancakes.
instruction_lines: In a bowl mix together ½ cup milk 2 tbsp oil 3 tbsp sugar and an egg.
Now add ¾ cup of all purpose flour and ¼ tsp salt and 1 tsp of baking powder.
Now add some batter in a non-stick pan (do not grease with oil, butter etc.)
Repeat the process with all the batter. Serve and enjoy.
